tasks.description: Compose the private account storage work plan with an authoritative final readiness check.
constraints: Internal forward read-only SQL and focused local fixture. Exact unified diff in JSON; controller applies and tests. No role grants, public deletion route, storage deletion, worker, Auth, staging or changes to prior migrations.

Combine validated 061 media page and 062 namespace/guest holds into one internal plan suitable for future worker. Take owner ID only; always read the first page so deleted objects naturally disappear and a cursor cannot hide survivors. Return at most 20 validated photo IDs and owner, the blocked/waiting and guest/orphan counts, and a boolean storage_ready. Only true when the canonical private bucket exists, no safe object is left, no blockers, namespace or in-flight counts remain. No deleted_at shortcut, actual metadata evidence required. Return SQL NULL if the exact 060 queue/receipt is absent. Never return raw storage names or mutate state.

Reuse accepted projections and their scope. Explicitly lock down function execute to internal owner only. Add gate-covered version-compatible pgTAP for partial page, still owned object after retry, clean evidence after canonical fixture object removed, each blocker preventing readiness, absent/public bucket, forged request, isolation and source rows intact. T082/T083 remain open for actual worker/data/Auth.

acceptance_criteria.description: Scoped forward SQL and version-aware fixture diff.
PostgreSQL clean/upgrade prove readiness never bypasses tracked objects or holds.
